headline: Zero-click exploits targeted iOS, Android users in Russia-linked campaign
summary: Researchers uncovered a large-scale watering-hole campaign using zero-click n-day exploits to infect iOS and Android devices through compromised or fake websites. BleepingComputer says the attack is associated with Russian hackers, while Ars Technica reports researchers believe the group may be Kremlin-sponsored and was likely pursuing diplomatic targets.

claims.statement: A large-scale watering-hole campaign used zero-click exploits to target iOS and Android users via compromised or fake sites.
